zones.title: Identify
zones.body: CRM lookup by VIN and number. Returns the greeting name and the vehicle label, never the identifiers.

panels.title: AR-10 Identify customer
panels.body: Identity from the UUI: VIN for an in-car call, the phone number for an IVR call. The model never sees either. An unknown caller is identified by spoken data points through IdentifyCaller (AR-18).
